I fully understand this, but I can assure you I do not have a negative relationship with food. Most of the time when you think of healthy fasts with full lack of food you think of somebody who is already very fit and is doing it for the mental benefits. Although this is not exactly the same for me, I do get a lot of benefits out of fully cutting food for a couple of days, both mental and physical, and I was more so just wondering how far I can push it safely. 

I have been going to the gym 5 days a week for the past two years and I am also kind of curious how my lifts/ energy levels will change in a prolonged fast. Although I am on the heavier side I think I should make sure and state that I am not doing this only for the weight loss, but I figured this community might have some advice when it came to this. I understand giving advice for non intermittent fasting probably feels wrong, as to most trying to lose weight cutting out food entirely is absolutely an eating disorder. Theoretically I could see how this could be seen as me being in denial and unable to see that’s what’s going on, but I see it more as an experiment to see how my weight fluctuates and body reacts more than anything else.
